title: 電信服務
description: 電信與網路服務相關用語

sentences.en: I'd like to sign up for a new phone plan.
sentences.zh: 我想申辦一個新的手機方案。

sentences.en: How much data is included in this plan?
sentences.zh: 這個方案包含多少數據流量？

sentences.en: I'm not getting any signal in my area.
sentences.zh: 我在這個地區收不到訊號。

sentences.en: I need a new SIM card for my phone.
sentences.zh: 我需要一張新的 SIM 卡。

sentences.en: When does my contract expire?
sentences.zh: 我的合約什麼時候到期？

sentences.en: I'd like to upgrade my phone.
sentences.zh: 我想升級我的手機。

sentences.en: My internet connection is very slow.
sentences.zh: 我的網路連線很慢。

sentences.en: Can I switch to a cheaper plan?
sentences.zh: 我可以換到比較便宜的方案嗎？

sentences.en: I want to add an international calling package.
sentences.zh: 我想加購國際通話方案。

sentences.en: How do I check my remaining data usage?
sentences.zh: 我要怎麼查剩餘的數據用量？

sentences.en: I've exceeded my data limit this month.
sentences.zh: 我這個月已經超過數據上限了。

sentences.en: Can I keep my old phone number?
sentences.zh: 我可以保留原來的電話號碼嗎？

sentences.en: I'd like to port my number to your network.
sentences.zh: 我想把號碼攜碼到你們的電信公司。

sentences.en: The Wi-Fi router isn't working properly.
sentences.zh: Wi-Fi 路由器運作不正常。

sentences.en: I need to activate my new SIM card.
sentences.zh: 我需要啟用我的新 SIM 卡。

sentences.en: What are your family plan options?
sentences.zh: 你們有什麼家庭方案的選項？

sentences.en: I'm being charged for services I didn't request.
sentences.zh: 我被收了沒有要求的服務費用。

sentences.en: Can you send a technician to fix my connection?
sentences.zh: 你們可以派技師來修理我的網路嗎？

sentences.en: I'd like to cancel my subscription.
sentences.zh: 我想取消我的訂閱。

sentences.en: Is there a penalty for early termination?
sentences.zh: 提前解約有違約金嗎？

sentences.en: My phone bill is much higher than usual.
sentences.zh: 我的電話帳單比平常高很多。

sentences.en: Do you offer unlimited data plans?
sentences.zh: 你們有提供無限流量的方案嗎？

sentences.en: I need to set up voicemail on my phone.
sentences.zh: 我需要在手機上設定語音信箱。

sentences.en: Can I get a temporary prepaid SIM card?
sentences.zh: 我可以買一張臨時的預付卡嗎？

sentences.en: The call quality has been very poor lately.
sentences.zh: 最近通話品質很差。

sentences.en: I'd like to add a second line to my account.
sentences.zh: 我想在帳戶下新增第二條線路。

sentences.en: How do I unlock my phone?
sentences.zh: 我要怎麼解鎖我的手機？

sentences.en: Is 5G available in my neighborhood?
sentences.zh: 我家附近有 5G 訊號嗎？

sentences.en: I want to enable international roaming.
sentences.zh: 我想開啟國際漫遊。

sentences.en: Can you explain the charges on my bill?
sentences.zh: 你可以解釋一下帳單上的費用嗎？
